purpose: W3 localization quality test only - evaluates ElevenLabs Dubbing v1 API voice quality independently, before any lip-sync or production decision.
watermark_caveat: watermark=true was required because the connected ElevenLabs account is on the free tier; watermark-free dubbing requires a Starter+ subscription. ElevenLabs applies a watermark to free-tier dubs, which may affect the sample and should be factored into human perceptual review. A clean re-run is possible if/when the account is upgraded.

source.transcript_text: I know, most of them take ages. That's why Freecash has a 4.7 on Trustpilot, and they pay me on the same day, so the money's solid.
source.selection_rationale: Continuous visible-speaking (onscreen_mouth_speaking_this_line=true per reports/A_EN_speaker_visual_analysis.json) creator talking-head section with no cuts; contains specific claims (brand name, rating, timing) useful for judging native German pronunciation of numbers/proper nouns and natural cadence.
source.no_new_extraction_performed_on_final_ass: Source clip was extracted read-only from final/A_EN.mp4 into a scratch temp file for submission; final/A_EN.mp4 and all other final/A_*.mp4 assets were not modified.

output.note: Audio track only was replaced with ElevenLabs' German dub; original video/mouth movement is untouched (English lip movement). fal.ai lip-sync intentionally NOT applied, per scope.

technical_validation.method: ffprobe stream inspection + ffmpeg -f null full decode with zero stderr output

perceptual_quality.note: Per explicit instruction, perceptual quality (native pronunciation, cadence, voice similarity, absence of English accent/leakage, background audio preservation quality) is NOT auto-declared PASS. This requires human listening review.

scope_confirmation.cost_note: Single ~7s sample dub call; well within prior authorized budget.
